title: Calibration catchup playbook - 1:1 prep (Juno)
content:
Goal: run a short calibration-style 1:1 focused on priorities, escalation readiness, and actionable coaching for Priya (report). Keep it to 30 minutes; walk out with 3 concrete follow-ups and one calibration note for my skip-level.

Context / quick state: Priya is the lead on kv-cache rollout and local prefix caching for Dedicated customers. Last week we saw a 12% tail-latency spike on p99 for 4k seqs after a kernel update (INF-4231). She's juggling on-call, a rewrite PR for async batching, and onboarding a new SWE.

Desired outcomes for this meeting:
- Make sure Priya has a clear priority order (what must ship this sprint vs. what can be deferred).
- Surface any blockers that require my intervention (people, infra, cross-team).
- Coach on delegation and runbook clarity for on-call handover.
- Agree 3 follow-ups with owners and due dates.

30-min agenda (timeboxed):
- (0-4m) Quick personal check-in (energy, capacity).
- (4-10m) Technical pulse: top-2 technical risks right now (kv-cache rollout, p99 regression).
- (10-18m) Priority huddle: what MUST ship this sprint, what can wait. I push back where scope creep is visible.
- (18-24m) People ops: handover for on-call, mentoring for new SWE.
- (24-28m) Ask: what do you need from me this week?
- (28-30m) Summarize follow-ups and expectations.

Prep notes to self (manager):
- Be direct about scope: remind Priya of the sprint commitment to the Dedicated latency SLOs.
- Bring up INF-4231 timeline: ask for a clear rollback vs. mitigation matrix.
- Check if async batching PR is blocking other teams (console, SDK). If yes, offer a pairing session or route to release engineer.
- Probe delegation: can senior IC shadow Priya on on-call playbook? If not, escalate to EM to backfill.

Key metrics to surface (have tabs ready):
- p50/p95/p99 token latency for 1k/4k sequences (last 7d vs baseline).
- % of requests served from prefix/KV cache (hit rate) and cost per token delta.
- CI flakiness of async-batching tests (failed runs in last 10 CI runs).

Coaching prompts (short, specific):
- "Walk me through the rollback decision tree for INF-4231 — where would you draw the threshold for rollback?"
- "Who is the fallback owner if you are on leave? Let’s name that person and schedule shadowing."
- "If this grows beyond scope, what can be deferred without violating SLAs?"

Notes to capture live in the meeting (copy to follow-up email):
- Priya: energy 6/10, stretched but motivated.
- Root cause hypothesis for p99 spike: kernel change + cache eviction pattern. Needs more signal from perf harness.
- Async-batching PR: currently blocked on test flakiness (test infra flakes on GPU CI).
- New SWE (Devika): productive but needs more pairing on batching internals.

Follow-ups (agreed, include owner and date):
1) Short mitigation plan for p99 spike (3 bullets: immediate rollback criteria, short-term mitigation config to revert kernel-path, perf-harness job to run nightly). Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-02-18.
2) Pairing session scheduled to unblock async-batching PR (90min pairing with release-engineer + test-owner). Owner: Juno to schedule; participants Priya & Mateo (release eng). Due: 2026-02-17.
3) On-call handover document and 2-run shadowing checklist for Devika (document + one shadowed pager run). Owner: Priya + Devika. Due: 2026-02-20.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: PR backlog and on-call overlap leads to slow review cycles. Mitigation: rotate a reviewer from another team for 2 sprints.
- Risk: If perf-harness can't reproduce spike, diagnosis stalls. Mitigation: escalate to infra perf team for a targeted trace capture window.

Calibration note for skip-level: (one paragraph)
- Priya is making steady progress but is currently operating at near-capacity. The p99 regression is a cross-cutting perf signal that needs insulation from her on-call burden. Recommend short-term reviewer support for async-batching and an infra trace run to accelerate RCA. No headcount ask yet; tactical reassignments preferred.

Post-meeting deliverables (I will do within 24h):
- Send a short follow-up email summarizing the 3 follow-ups and owners.
- Create a quick JIRA epic for the p99 mitigation work and link INF-4231.
- Ping infra-perf Slack channel and request a focused trace window for Feb 16-17.

Free-form scratch items (if time permits in meeting):
- Quick brainstorm on lowering tail latencies with a small A/B: conservative eviction policy + 1ms pre-warm for p99 traffic.
- Idea: temporary canary of cache rewrite in a low-volume region.

Reflection prompts for next 1:1 (write in calendar invite):
- What task took >3x expected time this sprint and why?
- Who did you delegate to this week and what was the result?
- One ask for me as your manager next week (concrete).

Tagline to end the doc: Keep the conversation lean, leave with precise next steps.
